caseName: United States v. Grower-Shippers Vegetable Ass'n
caseNameFull: United States v. Grower-Shippers Vegetable Association of Central California
attorneys: Acting Solicitor General Stern for the United States., George M. Naus for appellees.

opinions.text:
Per Curiam:

Judgment affirmed.

The Chief Justice, Mr. Justice Black, and Mr. Justice Douglas are of the opinion that probable jurisdiction should be noted and the case set down for argument.
